subject.title: feat(gateway): session dashboard domain — board RPCs, ticketed widgets, dashboard tool, per-agent persistence

question: Should dashboard boards support `mcp-app` widgets in this initial gateway contract, and if so what authorized public reconstruction/serving contract should clients use?
rationale: The branch persists and advertises `mcp-app` content but does not expose a renderable client contract; deciding whether to ship that capability or defer it determines the stable protocol and security boundary.

options.title: Define the MCP-app view contract
options.body: Publish an authorized descriptor or ticketed bridge that lets approved clients render MCP-app widgets, with focused protocol and lifecycle coverage.

options.title: Ship HTML-only boards first
options.body: Remove or reject `mcp-app` board content in this PR and add it later through a separately reviewed protocol design.

recommendation.title: Define the MCP-app view contract
recommendation.body: Publish an authorized descriptor or ticketed bridge that lets approved clients render MCP-app widgets, with focused protocol and lifecycle coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored both the merged dashboard UI foundation and the proposed gateway contract.
